Gold Purity Guide

24K, 22K, 21K, 20K & 18K Gold

Karat shows the proportion of gold in the alloy. Always compare the same purity and weight unit when reviewing gold rates.

99.9%

24 Karat

Very high-purity gold and a common benchmark for bullion-style pricing.

A widely used traditional jewellery purity with a higher gold content than lower karats.

Market Factors

What Affects the Gold Rate in Sargodha?

01

International Gold Prices

Global market movements can influence the underlying benchmark used in Pakistan.

02

USD / PKR Exchange Rate

Currency movement can change the Pakistani value of internationally priced gold.

03

Local Market Conditions

Local demand, supply and trading conditions can affect a shop's applicable quotation.

04

Purity & Weight

Karat and net gold weight directly change the metal value being compared.

05

Jewellery Charges

Making, labour, stones, wastage and other charges can make the final bill higher than the underlying metal value.

Gold Rate FAQs

What is the gold rate today in Sargodha?

The current reference values are loaded dynamically in the rate cards and table above. Gold prices can change during the day, so confirm the applicable local quote before a transaction.

How can I check today's gold rate in Sargodha?

Use this page to compare the current purity and weight figures, check the update date, then contact SM Gold to confirm the latest available local quotation.

What is the 21K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The 21K rate is displayed dynamically in the 21K card, comparison table and calculator. Compare it using the same weight unit as the quotation you are evaluating.

What is the 24K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The current 24K reference is shown prominently near the top of this page with per-tola, per-10-gram and per-gram values where available.

What is the difference between 21K and 24K gold?

21K contains approximately 87.5% gold, while 24K represents very high-purity gold. Their reference values therefore differ when the same weight is compared.

Is the gold rate the same as the final jewellery price?

No. A finished jewellery item can also include making or labour charges, stones, wastage, design and other applicable charges.

How many grams are in one tola of gold?

One traditional tola is approximately 11.664 grams.
